reasoning: This is a status-bar Wi-Fi signal strength indicator (specifically full signal shown as a solid circular sector) rather than a clear Wi-Fi symbol with concentric arcs. In isolation it reads as an abstract black wedge, pie slice, or baseball field, making it too ambiguous and UI-status-specific when a standard three-arc Wi-Fi icon exists.
